Darya Igorevna Astakhova [ 1 ] (born 26 January 2002) is a Russian tennis player. Astakhova has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of world No. 181, achieved on 20 March 2023, and a best WTA doubles ranking of No. 137, achieved on 16 January 2023. [ 2 ] She won her first WTA 125 title at the 2022 Iași Open , in the doubles draw, partnering with Andreea Roșca .
